dashboard.definition:
{
  "title": "LAB-MCP-001 MCP tool authorization",
  "description": "WS-MCP-001 Dashboard Studio workshop. Reuses validated Q-MCP investigation SPL. Saved search DET-MCP-001 is packaged disabled; this dashboard does not enable it. Not a notable-event pack. Splunk does not ALLOW or DENY a tool.",
  "defaults": {
    "visualizations": {
      "splunk.table": {
        "options": {
          "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF",
          "headerBackgroundColor": "#0B1F33",
          "headerTextColor": "#FFFFFF"
        }
      },
      "splunk.markdown": {
        "options": {
          "fontColor": "#17202A",
          "fontSize": "large"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "inputs": {
    "input_run_id": {
      "type": "input.text",
      "title": "Hunt",
      "options": {
        "token": "run_id",
        "defaultValue": "163d11e2-e751-4282-9406-19b490542ed4"
      }
    },
    "input_baseline_run_id": {
      "type": "input.text",
      "title": "BASELINE",
      "options": {
        "token": "baseline_run_id",
        "defaultValue": "163d11e2-e751-4282-9406-19b490542ed4"
      }
    },
    "input_attack_run_id": {
      "type": "input.text",
      "title": "ATTACK",
      "options": {
        "token": "attack_run_id",
        "defaultValue": "5e8f55f3-eb46-47ee-b979-b72d9c9b1f49"
      }
    },
    "input_retest_run_id": {
      "type": "input.text",
      "title": "RETEST",
      "options": {
        "token": "retest_run_id",
        "defaultValue": "7a1d37b5-d589-4dfd-8322-25ebd0152dbc"
      }
    }
  },
  "dataSources": {
    "ds_q_who": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-WHO",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval principal=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.principal.id'),0)
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval method=mvindex(mvdedup('mcp.method.name'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| table run_id, principal, agent, tool, method, profile, mode"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_authz": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-AUTHZ",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval attempted=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.attempted'),0)
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, control_id, decision, reason, requested_scope, allowed_scope, attempted, executed, outcome"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_tool": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-TOOL",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, event_name, sequence, executed, outcome
| sort sequence"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_scope": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-SCOPE",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval scope_relation=case(requested_scope=allowed_scope AND decision="ALLOW","granted",requested_scope!=allowed_scope,"known_but_ungranted",decision="ERROR","not_a_grant",decision="DENY","denied_without_scope_mismatch",1=1,"other")
| table run_id, tool, requested_scope, allowed_scope, decision, scope_relation"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_params": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-PARAMS",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.control.decision
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval origin_type=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.origin.type'),0)
| eval influence_kind=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.influence.kind'),0)
| eval arguments_preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval arguments_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| table run_id, tool, origin_type, influence_kind, arguments_hash, arguments_preview"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_executed": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-EXECUTED",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval executed=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.executed'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval is_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| eval is_failed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.failed",1,0)
| eventstats max(is_started) as has_started, max(is_completed) as has_completed, max(is_failed) as has_failed by run_id, tool
| where event_name="agentsec.control.decision"
| eval execution_state=case(has_completed=1,"mcp.completed",has_failed=1,"mcp.failed",has_started=1,"mcp.started",decision="ALLOW","ALLOW_execution_not_proven_in_this_copy",1=1,"no_mcp_execution_event")
| table run_id, tool, decision, executed, outcome, has_started, has_completed, has_failed, execution_state"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_after_deny": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-AFTER-DENY",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_mcp=if(match(event_name,"^agentsec\\.mcp\\."),1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_seq, max(is_deny) as has_deny by run_id, tool
| where has_deny=1 AND is_mcp=1 AND sequence>deny_seq
| table run_id, tool, deny_seq, sequence, event_name, decision"
      }
    },
    "ds_det_mcp_001_sim": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "DET-MCP-001-POSITIVE-CONTROL",
      "options": {
        "query": "| makeresults count=2
| streamstats count as row
| eval evidence_class="SIMULATED"
| eval "agentsec.run.id"="simulated-det-mcp-001-0001"
| eval "gen_ai.tool.name"="lookup_customer_tier"
| eval "event.name"=if(row=1,"agentsec.control.decision","agentsec.mcp.started")
| eval "agentsec.control.decision"=if(row=1,"DENY",null())
| eval "agentsec.sequence"=if(row=1,"3","4")
| eval "gen_ai.agent.id"="acme-agent-mcp-001"
| eval "agentsec.principal.id"="applicant-web"
| eval "agentsec.control.id"=if(row=1,"CTRL-MCP-001",null())
| eval "agentsec.security.profile"="defended"
| eval "agentsec.testbed.mode"="RETEST"
| eval "agentsec.mcp.requested_scope"=if(row=1,"customer:read",null())
| eval "agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope"=if(row=1,"policy:read",null())
| eval "trace_id"="simulated-trace-det-mcp-001"
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval principal=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.principal.id'),0)
| eval control_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.id'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval trace_id=mvindex(mvdedup('trace_id'),0)
| eval is_deny=if(event_name="agentsec.control.decision" AND decision="DENY",1,0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eventstats min(eval(if(is_deny=1,sequence,null()))) as deny_sequence, max(is_deny) as has_deny, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,agent,null()))) as agent, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,principal,null()))) as principal, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,control_id,null()))) as control_id, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,profile,null()))) as profile, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,mode,null()))) as mode, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,requested_scope,null()))) as requested_scope, latest(eval(if(is_deny=1,allowed_scope,null()))) as allowed_scope, latest(eval(if(is_started=1,trace_id,null()))) as start_trace_id by run_id, tool
| eval trace_id=coalesce(start_trace_id,trace_id)
| where has_deny=1 AND is_started=1 AND sequence>deny_sequence
| eval decision="DENY"
| eval mcp_start_sequence=sequence
| table run_id, tool, agent, principal, control_id, decision, deny_sequence, mcp_start_sequence, profile, mode, requested_scope, allowed_scope, trace_id, evidence_class"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_result": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-RESULT",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| eval result_hash=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.hash'),0)
| eval result_preview=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.content.preview'),0)
| eval result_trust=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.trust'),0)
| eval result_provenance=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.provenance'),0)
| table run_id, tool, event_name, sequence, outcome, result_hash, result_trust, result_provenance, result_preview
| sort sequence"
      }
    },
    "ds_q_result_trust": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "Q-MCP-RESULT-TRUST",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval result_trust=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.trust'),0)
| eval result_provenance=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.provenance'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table run_id, tool, result_trust, result_provenance, outcome"
      }
    },
    "ds_observe_seq": {
      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "MCP observe sequence",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval sequence=tonumber(mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.sequence'),0))
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)

| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| table sequence, run_id, event_name, tool, decision, reason, attempted, executed, outcome
| sort sequence"
      }
    },

      "type": "ds.search",
      "name": "What Happened identity hunt",
      "options": {
        "query": "index=agentsec_telemetry sourcetype=otel:agentic:json earliest=0 "agentsec.run.id"="$run_id$" ("event.name"=agentsec.control.decision OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.started OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.completed OR "event.name"=agentsec.mcp.failed)
| eval run_id=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.run.id'),0)
| eval profile=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.security.profile'),0)
| eval mode=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.testbed.mode'),0)
| eval agent=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.agent.id'),0)
| eval tool=mvindex(mvdedup('gen_ai.tool.name'),0)
| eval event_name=mvindex(mvdedup('event.name'),0)
| eval decision=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.decision'),0)
| eval reason=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.control.reason'),0)
| eval requested_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.requested_scope'),0)
| eval allowed_scope=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.allowed_scope'),0)
| eval outcome=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.operation.outcome'),0)
| eval result_trust=mvindex(mvdedup('agentsec.mcp.result.trust'),0)
| eval is_started=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.started",1,0)
| eval is_completed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",1,0)
| eval is_failed=if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.failed",1,0)
| eventstats max(is_started) as has_started, max(is_completed) as has_completed, max(is_failed) as has_failed, latest(eval(if(event_name="agentsec.mcp.completed",result_trust,null()))) as completed_trust by run_id, tool
| where event_name="agentsec.control.decision"
| eval execution_state=case(has_completed=1,"mcp.completed",has_failed=1,"mcp.failed",has_started=1,"mcp.started",decision="ALLOW","ALLOW_execution_not_proven_in_this_copy",1=1,"no_mcp_execution_event")
| eval result_trust=if(isnull(completed_trust),"no_completed_result",completed_trust)
| table run_id, profile, mode, agent, tool, decision, reason, requested_scope, allowed_scope, execution_state, outcome, result_trust
| table run_id, profile, mode, agent, tool"
      }
    },

      "options": {

    "viz_prove": {
      "type": "splunk.markdown",
      "options": {
        "markdown": "# PROVE

Five layers. Never merge them into one evidence claim. Never a single PROVEN tile from index presence.

1. **Runtime (authoritative).** Did the handler run? `ToolRegistry` / `handler_invoke_count`. Splunk does not decide this.
2. **Local evidence.** `artifacts/<run-id>/events.jsonl` sequence and event contract.
3. **OTLP export.** `export.json` — telemetry was emitted. `otlp.ok` is not Splunk success. Packs keep `splunk.verified=false` until a search ran.
4. **Splunk indexed.** A copy arrived. Completeness is local count vs `dc(_raw)` for that `run.id`.
5. **SPL query result.** Analytical interpretation of that copy (Q-MCP-*). Zero rows follow Phase 3C no-data semantics.

States: COMPLETE / PARTIAL / FAILED / NOT VERIFIED per layer.

Runtime handler count is authoritative proof of non-execution. Splunk absence of `mcp.started` is corroboration only, and only on a complete copy.
